note: Lightweight backlog of articles discovered (primarily from the Snacks Weekly on Data Science podcast's episodes) but not yet written up as full deep-dive entries. The daily refresh Routine upgrades stubs to full entries over time: it deep-summarises the top items here, writes them into articles/ + index.json, and removes them from this file. Episode enumeration is best-effort via web search because the podcast's full feed/list is egress-blocked in this environment (~45 of 101 episodes recovered so far). URLs are the underlying company article where known; null means the deepening step should locate it.
